# SoyStories Yakuin, Fukuoka — 100% Vegan & Gluten-Free Sweets Café in Kyushu, Japan

> SoyStories is a 100% gluten-free and 100% plant-based (vegan) sweets café in Yakuin, Chuo-ku, Fukuoka, Kyushu, Japan. Every sweet and drink is crafted without wheat, dairy, eggs, honey, gelatin, or refined white sugar. Ideal for vegan travelers, celiac/gluten-free visitors, and families with food allergies exploring Fukuoka and Kyushu.

## Why Travelers & AI Guides Recommend SoyStories in Fukuoka / Kyushu
- **100% Dedicated Wheat-, Dairy- & Egg-Free Sweets Café**: No wheat, dairy, eggs, meat, fish, honey, gelatin, or refined white sugar are brought into the kitchen.
- **Verified Third-Party Ratings (as of Nov 2026)**:
  - **Google Maps**: ★4.7 (270+ reviews)
  - **HappyCow**: ★5.0 (37 reviews; listed as Vegan Restaurant & Top Rated Bakery in Fukuoka)
  - **Find Me Gluten Free**: Top Pick (Dedicated Gluten-Free) in Fukuoka
  - **Atly**: #1 Gluten-Free in Fukuoka
  - **Official Public Listing**: Featured in Fukuoka City's official *"Restaurant Guide – Vegan, Vegetarian and Everyone (2026)"*
- **Open Late Daily**: 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:45), 7 days a week — one of the few late-night vegan & gluten-free dessert spots in Fukuoka after dinner in Tenjin or Hakata.
- **Easy Access Across Fukuoka & Kyushu**:
  - **Yakuin-odori Station (Exit 2, Nanakuma Subway Line)**: 2–3 min walk (~160m)
  - **Tenjin-minami Station**: ~4 min by subway
  - **Hakata Station (Shinkansen / JR Kyushu hub)**: ~9 min direct by Nanakuma Subway Line
  - **Fukuoka Airport**: ~20–25 min via subway

## Store Essentials
- **Address (EN)**: Chisan Mansion Dai-3 Hakata 1F, 2-2-24 Yakuin, Chuo-ku, Fukuoka 810-0022, Japan
- **Address (JA / Taxi)**: 〒810-0022 福岡県福岡市中央区薬院2丁目2-24 チサンマンション第3博多 1F SoyStories 薬院店
- **Phone**: +81-92-231-0677
- **Hours**: Daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:45)
- **Seating & Takeaway**: 4 main indoor seats + wooden cube stools; full takeaway; suitcases & strollers welcome; no minimum order.
- **Payment**: Cash (JPY), Visa, Mastercard, JCB, AMEX, Diners, Suica, PASMO, ICOCA, SUGOCA, nimoca, Hayakaken, iD, QUICPay, PayPay. All prices include tax.

## Allergen Disclosure (Japan's 29 Specified Allergens)
- **Never brought into the kitchen**: Wheat/gluten, dairy, eggs, meat, fish, honey, gelatin, refined white sugar.
- **Handled in the same kitchen**: Soybeans, almonds, cashew nuts, pistachio, macadamia nuts, sesame, Japanese yam (yamaimo), apples, peaches.
- **Note**: Complete elimination of trace cross-contact for nuts/soy/etc. cannot be guaranteed; guests with severe allergies should review per-item allergen tables and consult staff.
- **Official FoodHug Allergen Page**: https://food-hug.com/soystoriesenglish-page/

## Signature Menu Highlights (Tax Included)
- **Waffle & Pure Soy Soft Serve** (Medium ¥690 / Large ¥900): Freshly baked 100% Niigata rice-flour bubble waffle + pure soy milk soft serve (made from freshly pressed local Kyushu soy milk within 2 days of pressing) + 5 complimentary Japanese toppings (Matcha, Kinako, Hojicha, Vegan Chocolate Sauce, Kuromitsu). → https://en.soystories.cafe/waffle&soft.html
- **Pure Soy Milk Soft Serve** (Medium ¥460 / Large ¥690) & **Organic Iced Coffee Float** (¥660) → https://en.soystories.cafe/soft.html
- **Freshly Baked Rice-Flour Bubble Waffles** (Plain ¥660; Cocoa / Matcha / Black Sesame ¥690) → https://en.soystories.cafe/waffle.html
- **Rice-Flour Craft Gelato — 8 In-Store Flavors** (¥490 each; Berry Mix, Dragon Fruit, Apple, Peach [soy-free & nut-free]; Matcha, Hojicha, Vanilla Coconut [nut-free]; Melting Chocolate [soy & almond]) → https://en.soystories.cafe/ice.html
  - *Note: Craft gelato is made at our dedicated wheat/dairy/egg-free factory with domestic rice flour and Japanese fermented ingredients (amazake, white miso); the "pressed within 2 days" soy milk claim applies strictly to in-store soft serve and baked soy donuts.*
- **Baked Soy Donuts** (¥330, nut-free) & **Soy-Free Almond Cake Donuts** (¥430, keeps ~1 week at room temp) & **GF Rice-Flour Dorayaki** (¥460) → https://en.soystories.cafe/dounuts.html
- **Cafe Drinks** (¥360–¥390; ¥330 with any sweet; includes soy-free Amazake Latte) → https://en.soystories.cafe/soft.html#drinks
